name: localaibudget
description: Local-first AI budgeting app (NestJS + Angular + PostgreSQL + Ollama)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run start:dev" "npm --prefix client start"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix server run test:e2e && npm --prefix client test -- --watch=false
